notes:
— Intro: Monarch Benchworks builds low-latency market-data enrichment and recommendation engines for retail brokers.
— Meeting 2026-02-24 (FF transcript id ff_20260224_9a8b7c): AE Avery + SE Priya demoed Redwood Dedicated basics. Customer: very concerned about p95 latency during market open spikes. Quote: "We need predictable 20–40ms p95 for autocomplete + 100–150ms p95 for multi-turn chat under burst load."
— Primary workload: mix of short chat queries (10–60 tokens) + autocomplete (very short) + reranking (batch of top-50 candidates). Peak pattern: 200–400 TPS sustained for 5–10 minute windows, baseline 20–50 TPS.
— Cost sensitivity: high — internal target <= $0.20 per 1k prompt tokens (after optimizations). Looking to trade quantization vs output fidelity.
— Technical ask (explicit):
   * Benchmark variants: fp16 vs int8 vs AWQ-style 4-bit quantization on GPU pool.
   * Batching policy: evaluate micro-batching (batch windows 3–10ms) vs continuous batching. Measure impact on tail latency.
   * KV/prefix caching: test prefix cache effectiveness for common market queries; measure token savings and latency reduction.
   * Routing: multi-tier routing (hot pool for p95 SLO, warm pool for cost-saving throughput).
   * Perf metrics requested: p50/p95/p99, cold start time, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, cost/token.
— POC plan agreed: Redwood will run three perf profiles across dedicated pool sizes (2xA100 equiv, 4xA100 equiv, and a quantized-optimized pool). Monarch to provide a 48-hour replay trace (anonymized) and a small prompt set for quality checks.
— Quality constraints: no >5% degradation vs baseline outputs for core signals (embedding similarity, top-3 rerank precision). They will provide evaluation prompts and a small golden set.
— Security/compliance: require SOC2 attestation, SSO/SAML integration, KMS for key wrap, and region-specific data residency for EU/NA customers. Air-gapped option discussed but expensive.
— Sales notes: account champion is CTO (Elena Morales). Procurement timeline: procurement review in March; legal/data residency clause currently blocking signature.
— Action items:
   1) SE to prepare benchmark matrix and test harness (Priya) — due 2026-03-14.
   2) Infra to reserve dedicated pool candidates and test quantized kernels (Avery + Infra Ops).
   3) Monarch to share replay trace (secure FTP link) and golden prompts (by 2026-03-12).
   4) Schedule p0 perf run and review call (30–45min) after initial runs.
— Short, choppy CRM snippets from calls: "How small can we make p95 without losing rerank quality?"; "If quantization saves 35% cost and keeps top-3 intact we sign"; "Need dashboard showing cost/token per route".
— Other artifacts: referenced ticket JIRA-INF-1127 for kernel selection questions; drive deck includes cost projection table they liked.
— Notes on decision criteria: predictable p95 < 75ms across mixed workload OR demonstrable cost savings >25% with acceptable quality tradeoffs.
